args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
- Newsletter: Brightline Freight's latest newsletter spotlights "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" and links to a feature article on the topic (https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain).
- Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Reports that pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion).
